messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: There is a pregnancy exposure registry for women who use Wegovy during pregnancy.
The purpose of this registry is to collect information about the health of you and your baby.
Talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part in this registry.
Contact Novo Nordisk at 1-877-390-2760 or www.wegovypregnancyregistry.com.
Breastfeeding:
Ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using Ozempic or Wegovy injections.
Breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment with Wegovy tablets.
You should not breastfeed while using Rybelsus.
Triplet: ["Wegovy pregnancy exposure registry", "has participation instruction", "talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part in this registry"]

The relation 'has participation instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity provides instructions on how to participate in a program or registry, as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'tracks': The subject registry or system monitors or records the information specified by the object entity.
B. 'may appear in': A part of the subject entity may be present or appear in the entity specified by the object entity.
C. 'allows': The subject method or regimen enables the process or function specified by the object entity.
D. 'has participant': The subject study or trial includes the entity specified by the object as a participant or group.
E. 'is a': The subject entity is categorized as the object entity.
